STATUS: fail

SUMMARY: Four reproduced failures: Combobox Enter and blur on emptied text call `onChange(null)` against C5 and C8, Escape with two stacked dialogs closes the wrong one, and Tab from a focus-on-body state escapes a modal. A Tab with no matching panel also leaves a dangling `aria-controls`. Everything else I probed held up.

FILES TOUCHED: none (probe file `tests/zz_redteam_probe.test.tsx` created and deleted; `git status` matches the starting state)

FINDINGS:
- [blocking] Combobox C5: Enter with no active option and empty text calls `onChange(null)`. Reproduced: type to empty the field, press Enter, and the spy is called with `null`. C5 says Enter with no active option does nothing. The README documents this behavior, but it contradicts the criterion.
- [blocking] Combobox C8: blur after emptying the text calls `onChange(null)` and leaves the input at "", instead of restoring "Apple". Reproduced: `defaultValue="apple"`, clear, click outside, input value is "" (expected "Apple").
- [blocking] Dialog D6 stacking: outer A with nested B open, then sibling D opened later; Escape closes B, not D. Reproduced: `expected ['B'] to deeply equal ['D']`. `isTopmost` ranks by depth before recency, so the newest visible dialog is ignored.
- [blocking] Dialog D3 focus trap: with focus on `document.body`, `user.tab()` moves focus to a button outside the dialog. Reproduced. The trap only acts on keydowns whose target is inside the dialog.
- [blocking] Tabs T2 and the checklist's "every referenced id exists": a Tab with no matching TabPanel has `aria-controls` pointing at a missing id. Reproduced: `document.getElementById(tabB.getAttribute("aria-controls"))` is null. The README acknowledges this as a usage requirement, but the code does not guard against it.
- [minor] Combobox ArrowUp when closed does nothing and does not open. Not a spec violation, but inconsistent with ArrowDown. Not reproduced as a failure.
- [minor] Tabs arrow keys without a focused tab in the list skip `preventDefault`. Not reproduced as a failure.

CHECKS:
- Tabs P2 controlled parent ignores `onValueChange`, arrow still calls handler, selection unchanged → pass
- Tabs P3 first and last disabled, End/Home/wrap skip disabled → pass
- Tabs P4 single enabled tab, arrows keep focus, no crash → pass
- Tabs P5 `defaultValue` matches nothing → falls back to first enabled, tabindex 0 → pass
- Tabs P6 ids with "a b" and "x/y", two instances on one page, unique and whitespace-free → pass
- Tabs P7 removing the selected tab leaves exactly one selected → pass
- Tabs P8 StrictMode, arrows and wrap → pass
- Tabs P9 tab inserted before the fallback in DOM order → selects it → pass
- Tabs P10 duplicate values → pass (not a crash)
- Tabs T-x Tab from outside lands on selected tab, Tab again moves to panel → pass
- Tabs P1 dangling `aria-controls` → FAIL (see above)
- Dialog D-c backdrop click closes; content click and drag-from-content don't → pass
- Dialog D-d Escape in open Combobox closes only the popup; closed Combobox lets Escape close the dialog → pass
- Dialog D-e focus returns to opener after parent-driven close → pass
- Dialog D-f controlled parent ignoring `onOpenChange` keeps dialog open → pass
- Dialog D-g nested dialogs render both → pass
- Dialog D-a stacked dialogs Escape → FAIL (see above)
- Dialog D-b Tab from body → FAIL (see above)
- Combobox C-a Enter with no active option, empty text → FAIL (see above)
- Combobox C-b blur after emptying → FAIL (see above)
- Combobox C-c `(`, `.`, `[` typed text via fireEvent.change → no throw, No results shown → pass
- Combobox C-d all options disabled, ArrowDown/ArrowUp → no active, no loop → pass
- Combobox C-e ArrowDown then ArrowUp wraps to Grape, Enter selects it → pass
- Combobox C-f Enter in form when open doesn't submit; closed Enter submits once → pass
- Combobox C-g controlled ignores onChange, Escape and blur keep "Apple" → pass
- Combobox C-h user onKeyDown called, className and placeholder forwarded → pass
- Combobox C-i empty options, value "nope" shows "", ArrowDown → "No results" → pass
- Combobox C-j external controlled value change updates text → pass
- Combobox C-k disabled option click does nothing, enabled click selects and keeps focus → pass
- Combobox C-l Escape restores label, aria-expanded false, no aria-activedescendant, no onChange → pass
- Combobox C-m "AP" matches Apple and Grape, listbox named by label → pass
- Combobox C-x Enter on an active option selects it → pass

OPEN QUESTIONS:
- C5/C8 vs README: the README deliberately clears the value on Enter or blur with empty text. Decide whether the spec or the README wins. As written, the code fails C5 and C8.
- Should a Tab with no panel be an error, a documented requirement (README already says so), or a guarded omission of `aria-controls`? The checklist's "every referenced id exists" argues for the last.
- Are the stacking and body-focus Tab leaks in scope for D3 and D6, or follow-up work?
